videos.title: Lam：鉬金屬化與 ALTUS Halo
watchFor: 互連縮小時需要重新評估材料，而非只縮小幾何。
鉬是此產品案例的材料；不能直接套用到銅、鈷、釕或鎢課程。
比較電阻、薄膜沉積與整合限制，分開供應商說明及自己的驗證。
watchForEn: Shrinking interconnects requires reconsidering material choices, not only geometry.
Molybdenum belongs to this product case; do not transfer it directly to copper, cobalt, ruthenium or tungsten lessons.
Compare resistance, deposition and integration constraints while separating vendor statements from your verification.
videos.scope: 本課「鈷與釕互連研究」的延伸背景。用鉬 ALD 案例比較金屬互連材料轉換；不是其他金屬的通用配方。 影片並非本課每一道步驟的實拍。
videos.scopeEn: Related background for Cobalt and ruthenium interconnect research. Use the molybdenum-ALD case to compare interconnect material transitions; it is not a universal recipe for other metals. It is not footage of every step in this course.
videos.titleEn: ALTUS Halo: Ushering in the Molybdenum Era of Semiconductor Metallization
videos.originalTitle: ALTUS Halo: Ushering in the Molybdenum Era of Semiconductor Metallization
videos.author: Lam Research
videos.captionNote: 字幕與翻譯由原平台提供；下列中英重點由本學院依官方介紹另行撰寫，不是逐字稿或時間軸。
videos.captionNoteEn: Captions and translations depend on the source platform. The bilingual points are original academy guides based on official descriptions, not a transcript or timestamped account.
videos.before: 先問：「比較塊材與奈米線的電阻率概念」需要哪種材料或介面證據？畫出本課與影片案例的共同處及不同處。
videos.beforeEn: Ask what material or interface evidence Compare bulk and nanoscale-wire resistivity requires. Draw the common ground and differences between this course and the video case.
videos.after: 把「量測電阻對導電面積的關係」列為查證任務：面積量測誤差會影響材料比較。 本步須保留至少一項直接觀測與一項推論的區別。
videos.afterEn: Follow-up evidence task for Measure resistance versus conducting area: Area-measurement errors affect material comparison. Preserve the distinction between at least one direct observation and one inference.

courses.summary: 鈷與釕互連研究涉及跨國材料、設備與量測合作。本課程地圖選用imec 魯汶研究園區（Tower 代表點）作為公開研究或設備技術的代表位置。課程練習以公開原理連結圖形、材料與驗證，不宣稱此處為唯一發明地、所有技術的生產工廠或實際機台位置。
courses.summaryEn: Cobalt and ruthenium interconnect research involves international collaboration in materials, equipment and metrology. The map uses imec Leuven research campus: Tower reference as a public research or equipment-technology reference. Exercises connect patterns, materials and validation through public principles; this is not claimed to be the sole invention site, a factory producing every technology, or an instrument location.

history.title: 公開混合圖案化整合案例
history.text: imec 說明 SAQP 與 EUV 阻擋圖案化如何共同服務金屬層整合。這是產業研發沿革，不表示本課程全部技術於當年或此地發明。
history.textEn: imec described combining SAQP and EUV block patterning for metal-layer integration. This is research history, not a claim that every course technology was invented there or then.

courses.connection: 比較相關課程時，逐項追蹤材料、圖案形成方式、誤差與驗收證據的差異；相似原理不表示配方可直接移植。
courses.connectionEn: Compare related courses by materials, pattern formation, errors and acceptance evidence. Similar principles do not make recipes directly transferable.
